newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel-low sulphur quiet but higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel-low sulphur quiet but higher.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run was pegged firmer on the back of strong crude, but buying interest was less than enthusiastic.

"There's one buyer and two cargoes, so it's a bit of pressure on prices even with crude," said one dealer. Cargoes were pegged around $150 fob NWE. One West African cargo already on the water was sold into New York at the equivalent of around $153 cif.
Russian straight run was thinner towards the tail end of the week with a NWE M-100 going for around two means -- $2 on Wednesday.
